name: wanjuan-ge
description: 万卷阁 — 离线古籍、佛道经咒、圣经与公版典籍阅读器

scripts.test: node --check server.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check tools/build-index.js && node --check tools/build-release.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const files=['server.js','package.json','VERSION','README.md','docs/manual.html','docs/SOURCES.md','docs/RELEASE.md','launchers/windows/万卷阁.bat','launchers/windows/万卷阁-无窗口.vbs','launchers/linux/wanjuan-ge.sh','launchers/macos/万卷阁.command','launchers/android-termux/install.sh','launchers/android-termux/start.sh','launchers/iphone-ipad-ish/install.sh','launchers/iphone-ipad-ish/start.sh','android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml','android/app/src/main/java/ge/wanjuan/reader/MainActivity.java','library/catalog.json','data/search-index.json'];const missing=files.filter((f)=>!fs.existsSync(f));if(missing.length){console.error('缺少文件：'+missing.join('、'));process.exit(1)}const lib=require('./lib/library');const stats=lib.stats();if(!stats.books){throw new Error('书库为空，请先运行 npm run index')}console.log('自检通过：'+stats.books+' 部书，版本 '+fs.readFileSync('VERSION','utf8').trim());"
